name: gui_ui_fixes
description: Fix 3 UI issues in Paper Trading V2 GUI: (1) Add missing system logs — connection logs (MCP connect/disconnect/reconnect), symbol CRUD logs (add/remove/status-change/activate/deactivate/change-model) via centralized logger_v2.log() API. (2) Fix button text overflow in Onboarding tab Actions column — buttons outgrow column width, need to setColumnWidth(4) larger or use QToolButton with smaller font. (3) Fix popup backgrounds and low-contrast text — all QDialog/ConfirmationDialog must have dark theme background (#2d2d2d) and readable text colors (white/light gray).

members.name: Logger_Dev
members.executionPrompt: Expert in centralized logging. Add logging calls via logger_v2.log() to: (1) gui_bridge.py — MCP connect/disconnect/reconnect events, polling start/stop, model registry operations. (2) gui_tab_onboarding.py — symbol add, remove, status change, activate, deactivate, change model (all already log via log_action but also need system log). (3) gui_tab_account.py — MCP token update, reconnect button clicks. (4) execution_layer_v2.py — verify existing logging and add any missing connection-level events. Use the already-available syslog() or log() function from logger_v2.

members.name: UI_Styler
members.executionPrompt: Expert PySide6 layout and styling. Fix: (1) Onboarding tab Actions column — buttons overflow column width. Increase column 4 width from 200→350, reduce button font size, wrap buttons or use QToolButton with icon+text. (2) All popups (QDialog, ConfirmationDialog, QMessageBox) — set dark background (#2d2d2d or #1e1e1e), white text, ensure COLOR_POSITIVE/COLOR_NEGATIVE/COLOR_WARNING colors have enough contrast on dark backgrounds. Use the existing COLOR_* constants from gui_components.py. Test with both QDialog and the custom ConfirmationDialog class.

members.name: UI_Reviewer
members.executionPrompt: Review all UI fixes: (1) Verify logging calls use correct level (INFO for normal events, WARNING for issues, ERROR for failures). (2) Verify buttons in Onboarding Actions column fit within the column width. (3) Verify all popups/dialogs have dark theme and readable text — test ConfirmationDialog, QMessageBox.warning/information, and custom QDialogs. (4) Reject if any popup has white background, low-contrast text, or buttons overflow. Provide screenshot-style description of fix verification.
